mapper.select: WITH standard_data AS ( SELECT main.diet_id, main.usr_id, main.std_cd, main.std_nm, tmplstd.tmpl_std_tp_cd AS std_tp_cd, com3.intg_cd_dp_val_desc AS std_tp_nm, main.diet_nm, main.diet_desc, main.diet_fav_flg, main.tray_id, main.tray_nm, main.rep_tray_cd, com2.intg_cd_dp_val_desc AS rep_tray_nm, com2.intg_cd_val_desc AS rep_tray_desc, main.tray_mand_flg, COALESCE( jsonb_agg( json_build_object( 'code', stddtl.nutr_cd, 'name', mnutr.nutr_nm, 'unitCode', mnutr.unit_cd, 'unitName', com1.intg_cd_dp_val_desc, 'mandatoryFlag', stddtl.nutr_mand_flg, 'weightFrom', stddtl.nutr_wgt_fm, 'weightTo', stddtl.nutr_wgt_to, 'formula', stddtl.nutr_foml )), '[]' :: jsonb ) AS nutrients, rct.unit_prc, rct.serv_qty, rct.adj_pct, rct.fnl_prc FROM diet_mgmt main LEFT OUTER JOIN diet_std_dtl_mgmt stddtl ON main.diet_id = stddtl.diet_id LEFT OUTER JOIN mst_nutr mnutr ON stddtl.nutr_cd = mnutr.nutr_cd LEFT OUTER JOIN com_intg_cd_dtl com1 ON ( com1.intg_cd = 'CD00012' AND com1.intg_cd_val_ctnt = mnutr.unit_cd ) LEFT OUTER JOIN com_intg_cd_dtl com2 ON ( com2.intg_cd = 'CD00015' AND com2.intg_cd_val_ctnt = main.rep_tray_cd ) LEFT OUTER JOIN tmpl_diet_std tmplstd ON ( main.std_cd = tmplstd.tmpl_std_cd ) LEFT OUTER JOIN com_intg_cd_dtl com3 ON ( com3.intg_cd = 'CD00014' AND com3.intg_cd_val_ctnt = tmplstd.tmpl_std_tp_cd ) LEFT OUTER JOIN diet_rct rct ON main.diet_id = rct.diet_id WHERE main.diet_id = #{dietId} GROUP BY main.diet_id, main.usr_id, main.std_cd, main.std_nm, tmplstd.tmpl_std_tp_cd, com3.intg_cd_dp_val_desc, main.diet_nm, main.diet_desc, main.diet_fav_flg, main.tray_id, main.tray_nm, main.rep_tray_cd, com2.intg_cd_dp_val_desc, com2.intg_cd_val_desc, main.tray_mand_flg, rct.unit_prc, rct.serv_qty, rct.adj_pct, rct.fnl_prc ) , food_data AS ( SELECT sub2.diet_id, jsonb_agg( json_build_object( 'sequence', sub2.fd_seq, 'mandatoryFlag', sub2.fd_mand_flg, 'separatedFlag', sub2.fd_sep_flg, 'capacityVolume', sub2.fd_capa_vol, 'typeCode', sub2.fd_tp_cd, 'typeName', comtp.intg_cd_dp_val_desc, 'unitCode', sub2.tray_unit_cd, 'unitName', comunit.intg_cd_dp_val_desc, 'code', sub2.fd_cd, 'name', sub2.fd_nm, 'recipeDescription', sub2.fd_rcp_desc, 'materials', sub2.materials, 'allergens', COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg( jsonb_build_object( 'id', alrg.alrg_id, 'name', alrg.alrg_nm ) ) FROM mst_alrg alrg WHERE alrg.alrg_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT unnest(string_to_array(sub2.fd_allergen_str, '|')::int[]) ) ), '[]'::jsonb) ) ORDER BY sub2.fd_seq ) AS foods, string_agg(sub2.fd_allergen_str, '|') as diet_allergen_str FROM ( SELECT diet_id, fd_seq, fd_mand_flg, fd_sep_flg, fd_capa_vol, fd_tp_cd, tray_unit_cd, fd_cd, fd_nm, fd_rcp_desc, COALESCE( jsonb_agg( json_build_object( 'code', mat_cd, 'name', mat_org_nm, 'originalCode', mat_org_cd, 'unitCode', mat_unit_cd, 'unitName', commat.intg_cd_dp_val_desc, 'recipeWeight', mat_rcp_wgt, 'calculationWeight', mat_calc_wgt, 'price', COALESCE(mat_prc, 0), 'receiptIncludeFlag', COALESCE(rct_incl_flg, 'N'), 'geos', geos, 'eyeReferenceName', eye_ref_nm, 'eyeReferenceUnitName', eye_ref_unit_nm, 'eyeReferenceWeight', eye_ref_wgt, 'categoryId', mat_cat_id, 'categoryName', mat_cat_nm, 'nutrients', nutrients, 'allergens', mat_allergens ) ORDER BY mat_cd ) FILTER (WHERE mat_cd IS NOT NULL), '[]' :: jsonb ) AS materials, string_agg(mat_allergen_str, '|') AS fd_allergen_str FROM ( SELECT sub0.diet_id, sub0.fd_seq, sub0.fd_mand_flg, sub0.fd_sep_flg, sub0.fd_capa_vol, sub0.fd_tp_cd, sub0.tray_unit_cd, sub0.fd_cd, sub0.fd_nm, sub0.fd_rcp_desc, sub0.mat_cd, sub0.mat_rcp_wgt, sub0.mat_calc_wgt, sub0.mat_prc, sub0.rct_incl_flg, sub0.mat_org_cd, sub0.mat_org_nm, sub0.mat_unit_cd, sub0.geos, sub0.eye_ref_nm, sub0.eye_ref_unit_nm, sub0.eye_ref_wgt, sub0.mat_cat_id, sub0.mat_cat_nm, sub0.nutrients, COALESCE( jsonb_agg( jsonb_build_object( 'id', alrg.alrg_id, 'name', alrg.alrg_nm ) ) FILTER (WHERE alrg.alrg_id IS NOT NULL), '[]' :: jsonb) AS mat_allergens, string_agg(alrg.alrg_id::TEXT, '|') AS mat_allergen_str FROM ( SELECT traydtl.diet_id, traydtl.fd_seq, traydtl.fd_mand_flg, traydtl.fd_sep_flg, traydtl.fd_capa_vol, traydtl.fd_tp_cd, traydtl.unit_cd AS tray_unit_cd, traydtl.fd_cd, traydtl.fd_nm, traydtl.fd_rcp_desc, fddtl.mat_cd, fddtl.mat_rcp_wgt, fddtl.mat_calc_wgt, fddtl.mat_prc, fddtl.rct_incl_flg, mstmat.mat_org_cd, mstmat.mat_org_nm, mstmat.unit_cd AS mat_unit_cd, (SELECT jsonb_agg( json_build_object( 'geoId', mstgeo.geo_id, 'regNo', mstgeo.reg_no, 'regNm', mstgeo.reg_nm, 'region', mstgeo.region ) ORDER BY mstgeo.geo_id) FROM tmpl_mat_geo tmplgeo INNER JOIN mst_geo mstgeo ON tmplgeo.geo_id = mstgeo.geo_id WHERE tmplgeo.mat_cd = fddtl.mat_cd GROUP BY tmplgeo.mat_cd ) AS geos, eyeref.eye_ref_nm, comeye.intg_cd_dp_val_desc as eye_ref_unit_nm, eyeref.eye_ref_wgt, matcat.mat_cat_id, matcat.mat_cat_nm, COALESCE( jsonb_agg( json_build_object( 'code', mstnutr.nutr_cd, 'name', mstnutr.nutr_nm, 'unitCode', mstnutr.unit_cd, 'unitName', comnutr.intg_cd_dp_val_desc, 'amount', (tmplmat.tmpl_nutr_amt / tmplmat.tmpl_mat_wgt) ) ORDER BY mstnutr.nutr_cd ) FILTER (WHERE mstnutr.nutr_cd IS NOT NULL), '[]'::jsonb) AS nutrients FROM standard_data main LEFT OUTER JOIN diet_tray_dtl_mgmt traydtl ON main.diet_id = traydtl.diet_id LEFT OUTER JOIN diet_fd_dtl_mgmt fddtl ON ( traydtl.diet_id = fddtl.diet_id AND traydtl.fd_seq = fddtl.fd_seq ) LEFT OUTER JOIN mst_mat mstmat ON mstmat.mat_cd = fddtl.mat_cd LEFT OUTER JOIN tmpl_mat tmplmat ON tmplmat.tmpl_mat_cd = mstmat.mat_cd LEFT OUTER JOIN mst_mat_eye_ref eyeref ON mstmat.eye_ref_id = eyeref.eye_ref_id LEFT OUTER JOIN tmpl_mat_rep matrep ON mstmat.mat_rep_id = matrep.mat_rep_id LEFT OUTER JOIN tmpl_mat_cat matcat ON matrep.mat_cat_id = matcat.mat_cat_id LEFT OUTER JOIN com_intg_cd_dtl comeye ON ( comeye.intg_cd = 'CD00012' AND comeye.intg_cd_val_ctnt = eyeref.eye_ref_unit_cd ) LEFT OUTER JOIN mst_nutr mstnutr ON tmplmat.tmpl_nutr_cd = mstnutr.nutr_cd LEFT OUTER JOIN com_intg_cd_dtl comnutr ON ( comnutr.intg_cd = 'CD00012' AND comnutr.intg_cd_val_ctnt = mstnutr.unit_cd ) GROUP BY traydtl.diet_id, traydtl.fd_seq, traydtl.fd_mand_flg, traydtl.fd_sep_flg, traydtl.fd_capa_vol, traydtl.fd_tp_cd, traydtl.unit_cd, traydtl.fd_cd, traydtl.fd_nm, traydtl.fd_rcp_desc, fddtl.mat_cd, fddtl.mat_rcp_wgt, fddtl.mat_calc_wgt, fddtl.mat_prc, fddtl.rct_incl_flg, mstmat.mat_org_cd, mstmat.mat_org_nm, mstmat.unit_cd, eyeref.eye_ref_nm, comeye.intg_cd_dp_val_desc, eyeref.eye_ref_wgt, matcat.mat_cat_id, matcat.mat_cat_nm ) sub0 LEFT OUTER JOIN tmpl_mat_alrg matalrg ON sub0.mat_cd = matalrg.mat_cd LEFT OUTER JOIN mst_alrg alrg ON matalrg.alrg_id = alrg.alrg_id GROUP BY sub0.diet_id, sub0.fd_seq, sub0.fd_mand_flg, sub0.fd_sep_flg, sub0.fd_capa_vol, sub0.fd_tp_cd, sub0.tray_unit_cd, sub0.fd_cd, sub0.fd_nm, sub0.fd_rcp_desc, sub0.mat_cd, sub0.mat_rcp_wgt, sub0.mat_calc_wgt, sub0.mat_prc, sub0.rct_incl_flg, sub0.mat_org_cd, sub0.mat_org_nm, sub0.mat_unit_cd, sub0.geos, sub0.eye_ref_nm, sub0.eye_ref_unit_nm, sub0.eye_ref_wgt, sub0.mat_cat_id, sub0.mat_cat_nm, sub0.nutrients ) sub1 LEFT OUTER JOIN com_intg_cd_dtl commat ON ( commat.intg_cd = 'CD00012' AND commat.intg_cd_val_ctnt = sub1.mat_unit_cd ) GROUP BY diet_id, fd_seq, fd_mand_flg, fd_sep_flg, fd_capa_vol, fd_tp_cd, tray_unit_cd, fd_cd, fd_nm, fd_rcp_desc ) sub2 LEFT OUTER JOIN com_intg_cd_dtl comtp ON ( comtp.intg_cd = 'CD00013' AND comtp.intg_cd_val_ctnt = sub2.fd_tp_cd ) LEFT OUTER JOIN com_intg_cd_dtl comunit ON ( comunit.intg_cd = 'CD00012' AND comunit.intg_cd_val_ctnt = sub2.tray_unit_cd ) GROUP BY sub2.diet_id ) , accessory_data AS ( SELECT diet_id, accs FROM ( SELECT accs.diet_id, COALESCE( jsonb_agg( json_build_object( 'sequence', accs.accs_seq, 'name', accs.accs_nm, 'price', accs.accs_prc, 'receiptIncludeFlag', accs.rct_incl_flg ) ORDER BY accs.accs_seq ) , '[]'::jsonb) AS accs FROM standard_data LEFT OUTER JOIN diet_accs accs ON standard_data.diet_id = accs.diet_id GROUP BY accs.diet_id ) sub1 ) SELECT a.diet_id, a.usr_id, a.diet_nm, a.diet_desc, a.diet_fav_flg, a.unit_prc, a.serv_qty, a.adj_pct, a.fnl_prc, json_build_object( 'code', a.std_cd, 'name', a.std_nm, 'typeCode', a.std_tp_cd, 'typeName', a.std_tp_nm, 'nutrients', a.nutrients ) AS standard, json_build_object( 'id', a.tray_id, 'name', a.tray_nm, 'representativeTrayCode', a.rep_tray_cd, 'representativeTrayName', a.rep_tray_nm, 'representativeTrayDescription', a.rep_tray_desc, 'mandatoryFlag', a.tray_mand_flg, 'foods', b.foods ) AS tray, c.accs, COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg( jsonb_build_object( 'id', alrg.alrg_id, 'name', alrg.alrg_nm ) ) FROM mst_alrg alrg WHERE alrg.alrg_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT unnest(string_to_array(diet_allergen_str, '|')::int[]) ) ), '[]'::jsonb) AS allergens, COALESCE( (SELECT jsonb_agg( jsonb_build_object( 'id', alrg.alrg_id, 'name', alrg.alrg_nm ) ) FROM diet_alrg_mgmt dietarlg INNER JOIN mst_alrg alrg ON dietarlg.alrg_id = alrg.alrg_id WHERE dietarlg.diet_id = a.diet_id) , '[]'::jsonb) AS excluded_allergens FROM standard_data a LEFT OUTER JOIN food_data b ON a.diet_id = b.diet_id LEFT OUTER JOIN accessory_data c ON a.diet_id = c.diet_id

mapper.select: SELECT std.tmpl_std_cd, std.tmpl_std_nm, std.tmpl_std_tp_cd, a.intg_cd_dp_val_desc AS tmpl_std_tp_nm, json_agg( json_build_object( 'code', dtl.tmpl_nutr_cd, 'name', b.nutr_nm, 'unitCode', b.unit_cd, 'unitName', c.intg_cd_dp_val_desc, 'mandatoryFlag', dtl.tmpl_nutr_mand_flg, 'weightFrom', dtl.tmpl_nutr_wgt_fm, 'weightTo', dtl.tmpl_nutr_wgt_to, 'formula', dtl.tmpl_nutr_foml )) AS nutrients FROM tmpl_diet_std std INNER JOIN tmpl_diet_std_dtl dtl ON std.tmpl_std_cd = dtl.tmpl_std_cd LEFT OUTER JOIN com_intg_cd_dtl a ON ( a.intg_cd = 'CD00014' AND a.intg_cd_val_ctnt = std.tmpl_std_tp_cd ) LEFT OUTER JOIN mst_nutr b ON dtl.tmpl_nutr_cd = b.nutr_cd LEFT OUTER JOIN com_intg_cd_dtl c ON ( c.intg_cd = 'CD00012' AND c.intg_cd_val_ctnt = b.unit_cd ) WHERE std.tmpl_std_cd = #{code} GROUP BY std.tmpl_std_cd, std.tmpl_std_nm, std.tmpl_std_tp_cd, a.intg_cd_dp_val_desc

mapper.select: SELECT tray_id, usr_id, tray_nm, rep_tray_cd, rep_tray_nm, rep_tray_desc, tray_mand_flg, CASE WHEN fd_no != 0 THEN foods END AS foods FROM ( SELECT mst.tray_id, mst.usr_id, mst.tray_nm, mst.rep_tray_cd, rtray.intg_cd_dp_val_desc AS rep_tray_nm, rtray.intg_cd_val_desc AS rep_tray_desc, mst.tray_mand_flg, json_agg( json_build_object( 'sequence', dtl.fd_seq, 'mandatoryFlag', dtl.fd_mand_flg, 'separatedFlag', dtl.fd_sep_flg, 'capacityVolume', dtl.fd_capa_vol, 'typeCode', dtl.fd_tp_cd, 'typeName', fdtp.intg_cd_dp_val_desc, 'unitCode', dtl.unit_cd, 'unitName', d.intg_cd_dp_val_desc ) ORDER BY dtl.fd_seq ) AS foods, count(CASE WHEN dtl.fd_seq IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS fd_no FROM usr_tray_mgmt mst LEFT OUTER JOIN usr_tray_dtl_mgmt dtl on mst.tray_id = dtl.tray_id LEFT OUTER JOIN com_intg_cd_dtl d ON ( d.intg_cd = 'CD00012' AND d.intg_cd_val_ctnt = dtl.unit_cd ) LEFT OUTER JOIN com_intg_cd_dtl fdtp ON ( fdtp.intg_cd = 'CD00013' AND fdtp.intg_cd_val_ctnt = dtl.fd_tp_cd ) LEFT OUTER JOIN com_intg_cd_dtl rtray ON ( rtray.intg_cd = 'CD00015' AND rtray.intg_cd_val_ctnt = mst.rep_tray_cd ) WHERE mst.tray_id = #{trayId} GROUP BY mst.tray_id, mst.usr_id, mst.tray_nm, mst.rep_tray_cd, rtray.intg_cd_dp_val_desc, rtray.intg_cd_val_desc ) sub1

SELECT CAST(SUBSTRING(mst.tmpl_tray_cd FROM 3) AS INTEGER) * -1 AS tray_id, 0 AS usr_id, mst.tmpl_tray_nm AS tray_nm, mst.tmpl_rep_tray_cd AS rep_tray_cd, rtray.intg_cd_dp_val_desc AS rep_tray_nm, rtray.intg_cd_val_desc AS rep_tray_desc, 'Y' AS tray_mand_flg, COALESCE( jsonb_agg( json_build_object( 'sequence', dtl.tmpl_fd_seq, 'mandatoryFlag', dtl.tmpl_fd_mand_flg, 'separatedFlag', dtl.tmpl_fd_sep_flg, 'capacityVolume', dtl.tmpl_fd_capa_vol, 'typeCode', dtl.fd_tp_cd, 'typeName', fdtp.intg_cd_dp_val_desc, 'unitCode', dtl.unit_cd, 'unitName', d.intg_cd_dp_val_desc ) ORDER BY dtl.tmpl_fd_seq ) FILTER (WHERE dtl.tmpl_fd_seq IS NOT NULL), '[]'::jsonb ) AS foods FROM tmpl_tray mst LEFT JOIN tmpl_tray_dtl dtl ON mst.tmpl_tray_cd = dtl.tmpl_tray_cd LEFT OUTER JOIN com_intg_cd_dtl d ON ( d.intg_cd = 'CD00012' AND d.intg_cd_val_ctnt = dtl.unit_cd ) LEFT OUTER JOIN com_intg_cd_dtl fdtp ON ( fdtp.intg_cd = 'CD00013' AND fdtp.intg_cd_val_ctnt = dtl.fd_tp_cd ) LEFT OUTER JOIN com_intg_cd_dtl rtray ON ( rtray.intg_cd = 'CD00015' AND rtray.intg_cd_val_ctnt = mst.tmpl_rep_tray_cd ) GROUP BY mst.tmpl_tray_cd, mst.tmpl_tray_nm, mst.tmpl_rep_tray_cd, rtray.intg_cd_dp_val_desc, rtray.intg_cd_val_desc
